author: Claude (independent verification track)
candidate: Z3-ONLY GENERATION OF THE FINAL ORBIT SET
scope: Q2 / Area-A. Residual read from the Round-80 archive; no frontier replay, no continuation search, no first-open tests.
scoping_note: The blocked-w2 lemma is used only as a reachable-legal-history invariant, exactly as its Round-83 proof establishes (it argues from the no-repeat history of the walk). It is not applied to arbitrary hand-built ExactState masks.

z3_relation.definition: q -> r iff there exist a phase f, a rotation-run length l in 0..5 and a weight-3 joint a with word_after(sigma^l(port(q,f)), a) a port of r
z3_relation.over_approximation_proof: a genuine Z3 opening of r from q is a macro edge from the walk's endpoint in q: l rotations then a weight-3 joint landing in r, with abandonment False and new_orbit True. The engine imposes strictly more: every rotation target unvisited, the joint target unvisited, sigma(p') visited (abandonment False), r closed, and one specific endpoint phase. All are dropped and the phase is quantified over all five, so no genuinely possible Z3 edge is omitted.
z3_relation.comparison: the Round-81 generic 4-joint relation and the Z3-only relation have IDENTICAL edge sets (verified per-orbit, not merely equal counts): 7,920 edges, out-degree 55, 1 SCC. Every orbit change the weight-2 joint can make is also makeable by some weight-3 joint from the same source orbit. Restricting to Z3 removes nothing at orbit level.

generation_necessity_proof: Every orbit of S must be opened fresh, and with F = 1 every fresh opening is a Z3 (Round 83). A Z3 opening of r is a macro edge departing the walk's current orbit, which at that moment is in A union the already-opened members of S. So the openings admit an order s_1..s_K in which each s_i has a Z3 predecessor in A union {s_1..s_{i-1}}. Conversely such an order is exactly a witness that every element of S is reachable from A inside the induced graph G[A u S] -- the greedy closure of A within A u S reaches all of S iff such an order exists. Reachability in the FULL graph is strictly weaker, since a path may pass through an orbit not selected into S.

stage_B_full_graph_reachable_cover.reason: the Z3 closure from A reaches every cover candidate in every one of the 6,657 states, so the restricted cover instance is identical to Round 79's

stage_C_cheap_cuts.one_step_cover_test: a cover living entirely inside the one-step Z3 image of A satisfies the induced condition trivially

stage_D_joint_cover_plus_generation.key_observation: cover solutions examined equals the number of instances, so in every single case the FIRST cover found was already induced-reachable; the induced condition never rejected even one cover solution
stage_D_joint_cover_plus_generation.witnesses: each SAT carries S, the explicit cover, and the generation order from A

negative_structural_result: STATIC COVER + ORBIT-LEVEL Z3 GENERATION IS EXHAUSTED. All 6,657 states admit a Z3-generated slack-cover final orbit set, and the induced-set condition -- the genuinely new constraint this round added -- rejected zero cover solutions.

derived_lemma_not_yet_exploited.statement: at most two future macro edges can have l < 5
derived_lemma_not_yet_exploited.derivation: F = 1 on every residual state, so no future abandonment is legal (Round 83). A pass entering a FRESH hexagon must therefore leave by natural rotation collision, i.e. it fills the hexagon and its departing edge has l = 5. By the Round-76/78 pass count exactly one hexagon receives two passes, and with F = 1 that must be the already-existing fragment. So only the current pass (if its hexagon is partial) and the fragment-repair pass can depart with l < 5.
derived_lemma_not_yet_exploited.why_it_looked_promising: the l = 5 Z3 relation has out-degree 10 rather than 55, a factor of 5.5 sparser
derived_lemma_not_yet_exploited.measured_outcome: insufficient at orbit level anyway. Under the (unsound, projection-only) assumption that ALL Z3 edges must have l = 5, only 10-50% of candidates are one edge from A -- but the full l=5 closure still reaches EVERY candidate in all 6,657 states. So even this sharpening closes 0 by reachability.
derived_lemma_not_yet_exploited.status: recorded as a sound derived fact; not used to close anything

what_could_still_constrain_a_multi_step_: landing phase of each Z3 opening -- the entering joint determines the arrival phase exactly, which the orbit-level relation discards
port occupancy / no-repeat across several selected orbits simultaneously, rather than one at a time
exact source-orbit reuse: how many openings a single pass through one orbit can supply
resource timing -- when the R_cap + Phi budget is spent relative to the openings
disclaimer: This project has not proved L6 >= 872, and nothing here bears on that.
